description: Figure 4 is a bar chart illustrating the number of participants (N=6) who highlighted each evaluation criterion as beneficial. The horizontal axis displays the evaluation criteria, which are labeled as “Retrieval of relevant fact-checks (FCs),” “Concise summaries and explanations,” and “Clarity of the interface.” The vertical axis represents the count of participants, scaled linearly from 0 to 6, with tick marks at integer intervals. Each criterion is represented by a single bar: the bar for “Retrieval of relevant fact-checks (FCs)” is colored dark blue and reaches a height of 6, indicating all six participants found it beneficial; the bar for “Concise summaries and explanations” is colored light blue and also reaches a height of 6; the bar for “Clarity of the interface” is colored green and reaches a height of 6. All bars are of equal height, visually indicating that each criterion was deemed beneficial by all six participants. The bars are arranged in descending order of value, though since all values are equal, the order is arbitrary. There are no additional visual elements such as shading, outlines, or annotations to emphasize any specific bar.
